hard_case: A `#[macro_export]` generator in `tests/export_support/mod.rs` is called as `crate::crate_called_table! { .. }` from another module of the same test crate, with no `use` and no `#[macro_use]`; the middle row sits on the limit.

mutants.equivalence_review: not equivalent: 5 against a limit of 5 no longer fits
not equivalent: 6 against a limit of 5 now fits

reasoning: Rows crate_call_under(3, 5, true), crate_call_at(5, 5, true) and crate_call_over(6, 5, false) sit under and on both sides of the limit, so `limit > width` fails crate_call_at and `limit + 1 >= width` fails crate_call_over. The generator `crate_called_table!` is `#[macro_export]` in tests/export_support/mod.rs and the invoking module calls it by the path `crate::crate_called_table!`, so ripr has to resolve the one exported definition of that name in the test crate.
